text.description_html:
Don-Jo 70-613 3.5" x 15" Door Push Plate

Common size door push plates primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, churches and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality material for longevity. Packaged with matching oil rubbed bronze mounting screws for easy installation. The Push Plate is 3.5" wide and 15" long.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 70-613 Door Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged With Mounting Screws

    • Sold Individually
